description: test_novelty_key_is_category_platform_tuple is a tautological test. It sets up history with 10 (scan-requests, coconala) entries, calls pick_next, and asserts only 'result is not None'. The assertion would pass even if the implementation ignored history entirely, or used a different key shape, or chose an arbitrary item. The trailing comment 'Verified by the API not accepting any other key shape' is aspirational — there is no actual check on key shape, and pick_next accepts any dict for history. PROP-novelty-key-aligned (required:true) is therefore unverified by this test.

evidence.snippet:
history = [{"category": "scan-requests", "platform": "coconala"}] * 10
result = pick_next(menu=menu, log_tail=[], history=history, blockers=set(),
                  now_ts=1782900000, budget=Budget.FULL)
assert result is not None
# The picker may apply novelty quota; key shape is (category, platform)
# Verified by the API not accepting any other key shape
